destination.write_not_committed: The connector proved that the destination write did not commit.
destination.write_partial: The write stopped after a proven committed prefix.
destination.write_started: The explicit destination write boundary has been entered.
destination.write_unknown: The destination write outcome is not fully proven.
mapping.blocked: At least one mapping is blocked by contract or policy evidence.
mapping.ready: Every mapping rule is automatic or explicitly reviewed.
mapping.review_required: At least one mapping requires an explicit operator decision.
mapping.started: Polymorph is comparing source and destination contracts.
preflight.started: A complete no-write preflight is checking the source stream.
run.blocked: The run stopped before an unsafe or unproven write.
run.progress: Prepared {records_prepared} of {records_total} record(s) for the destination stream.
run.ready: The route passed preparation and is waiting for an explicit execute call.
run.started: A new local route preparation started.
source.accepted: The source contract contains {fields} field(s); immutable snapshot proven is {snapshot_proven}.
source.inspecting: Polymorph is inspecting the source before selecting a connector.
